review_improvement: Exposes the rocBLAS/clBLAS identity conflict and replaces privileged global loader mutation with branch-correct isolated numerical evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: rocBLAS and clBLAS expose different APIs and link names even when both perform BLAS operations. Building rocBLAS does not make `-lclBLAS` exercise it. A successful binary can also resolve an older system library through the modified loader path, so compile/link trace and runtime hashes are necessary to prove which library was actually tested.
